== Title ==
<span lang="ja">LIN-V8K (エルアイン・ヴィーエイトケイ)</span>. No uniqueness marker precedes the printed title.

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">地雷を敷設できる。また、ターン中の好きな時に、1フォース消費して同じ位置カードにある地雷を1つ“無効化”（ロスト）させられる。</span>

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">代表的な地雷敷設／爆破用装甲ドロイド。軍事目的に転用された。地雷や爆薬を仕掛けたり除去したりする。このLIN-V8Kはジャワに再改造されたもの。</span>

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — [[LIN-V8K (Elleyein-Veeatekay)]].

'''Lore''' — A typical armored mine-laying and demolition droid. It was converted to military use. It plants and removes mines and explosives. This LIN-V8K was modified again by Jawas.

'''Game text''' — May lay mines. Also, at any time during a turn, may spend 1 Force to “disable” (lose) one mine at the same location card.

== Comparison with the English printing ==
Lore says Jawas modified this LIN-V8K again, and names mine-laying and demolition. English lore is ore and spice mines converted to military use. Game text uses また, 位置カード, and “無効化” rather than OR / same site / 'defuse'. Title kana is エルアイン・ヴィーエイトケイ.<ref>[[:File:Premiere-L-linv8k-decipher-archive.gif|Original English face]], [[LIN-V8K (Elleyein-Veeatekay)]].</ref>
